notes: The export button that used to sit on every album card in the Albums tab is gone. It crowded each card and was easy to hit by mistake when all you wanted was to open an album.

Exporting one album now lives in Manage albums: every album row carries its own export button beside Rename and Delete, so the things you can do to an album sit together in the one place you manage them.

The button does exactly what it did before: it writes a .zip holding that album and its songs - the audio, the tags and the cover art - so importing it on another device rebuilds that one album and nothing else.
It still asks first, naming the album and how many songs are about to be written, and cancelling writes nothing at all.
The Albums list reads cleaner without a button on every card: the cover, the name, the artist, the song count and the open and close chevron are exactly as they were.
Manage albums is otherwise unchanged: the search box, Rename, the cover picker, Delete and the It is mine restore are all where they were.
